name_zh: 菲格雷斯/哥斯达黎加/废军/民主/福利/生态/何塞/和平/生物
core_mode: M609 废除军队/福利民主/生态和平/哥斯达黎加模式/无军国家
description_zh: 何塞·菲格雷斯（1906-1990），哥斯达黎加前总统，1953-1966年在位。他是一位哥斯达黎加政治家，前军人，通过领导废除军队运动，实现了哥斯达黎加从军人统治到民主制度的转变。他实施了福利国家政策，建立了社会福利体系，推动了哥斯达黎加的生态保护和和平发展。他的统治时期，哥斯达黎加被称为"无军国家"，成为世界和平与民主的典范。
description_en: Jose Figueres (1906-1990), former President of Costa Rica, served from 1953 to 1966. He was a Costa Rican politician and former military officer, led the Abandon Army Movement to achieve Costa Rica's transition from military rule to democracy. He implemented welfare state policies, established social welfare system, promoted Costa Rica's ecological protection and peaceful development. His rule period, Costa Rica was known as "No Army Country", became a world model of peace and democracy.
